activities.name: Complete Physical Examination
activities.label: Complete Physical Examination
activities.description:
The complete physical examination
excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast
examinations, unless clinically indicated.
All remaining physical examinations
throughout the study should include a
symptom-directed physical evaluation, as well as an examination of the heart, lungs,
abdomen, neurological system, thyroid,
and visual examination of the skin. See
Section 8.2.1.
Assess for TB risk factors, and for signs
and symptoms of active TB, including
exam of peripheral lymph nodes (see
Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).

activities.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
activities.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
activities.description:
Perform as indicated based on participant
status and standard of care. May be
performed by a qualified personnel per
local regulations.
Every symptom-directed examination
should also include an examination of the
heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological
system, thyroid, and visual examination of
the skin.
At least every third month after screening,
assess for TB risk factors, and for signs
and symptoms of active TB, including an
assessment of peripheral lymph nodes
(Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).

activities.name: X-ray of Chest
activities.label: X-ray of Chest
activities.description:
Performed locally only if skin TB test,
QuantiFERON®-TB Gold test, or
T-SPOT®.TB is positive or other
indications of TB are present. Interpreted
and reported by a radiologist or
pulmonologist.
Chest x-ray is not required if one was
performed within 6 months before Visit 1
and sufficient documentation exists for the
TB evaluation (Sections 8.2.4 and 8.2.10).
A chest CT scan can be used instead of a
chest x-ray if the chest CT scan was
performed within the same time window
(Section 8.2.4).

activities.name: DXA scan of whole body
activities.label: DXA scan of whole body
activities.description:
See Section 8.1.3.1. If not completed, will
not be considered a protocol deviation.
It is recommended to perform successful
baseline scan between Visits 1 and 2 and
no later than Visit 3.
Participants should fast for at least 8 hours
without eating or drinking (except water)
before each DXA scan. No water should
be consumed within 2 hours before each
DXA scan.  *At ED, repeat if more than
3 months have passed since the last
scan.

biomedicalConcepts.name: M. tuberculosis IFN Gamma Response (TB Test)
biomedicalConcepts.label: M. tuberculosis IFN Gamma Response (TB Test)
biomedicalConcepts.reference:
Participants who had a tuberculin skin test
(TST) must have the test read 48 to 72
hours after placement. The test does not
need to be read at the site but must be read
by a trained professional and results must
be presented to the site prior to first dose
of study interventions.
Local staff must be qualified to administer
and interpret the test per the local
regulation.
See Sections 8.2.10 and 10.2.
